description: Makes a screen share link for two (WebRTC, browser to browser, encrypted, no account or app): your person shares a screen, window or tab and one viewer watches on any device. No video passes through the API. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

locale.description: The language the screen share page is shown in: en, de, es, fi, fr, it, nl, pl or pt. Default en. Use the language of the person you are giving the link to.

name: screen_share_online
title: Screen Share Online
